name: LOCAL_LLM_HEALTH_GATE_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: LOCAL_LLM_HEALTH_GATE_20261107 — trade-close-llm-analyzer-source failed every weekly run
(exit 1, log 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-01) with 'Refusing to run --apply with failed health
checks'. Two checks of the preflight could not pass, for reasons unrelated to machine safety:
(1) no_unsafe_jobs excluded only self, parent and grandparent, but under cron the tree is
cron -> /bin/bash -c -> safe_flock.sh -> analyzer -> health check, so the shell whose command
line NAMES trade_close_llm_analyzer.py --apply sat one level above the exclude set and the lane
reported itself as a concurrent unsafe job. The exclusion is now the whole ancestor chain; a
genuinely concurrent classifier/analyzer --apply is still flagged.
(2) disabled_model_routing required qwen3:14b to resolve to LOCAL_LLM_SAFE_MODEL, but after the
local-generative retirement local_llm._resolve_model returns LOCAL_GENERATIVE_RETIRED with
DISABLED_MODELS == {'*'} — every model blocked, the stronger form of the property the check
exists to prove. A total blocklist now satisfies the check whichever model the request resolves
to; a request that resolves to itself, an unblocked request, an empty resolution and a partial
blocklist with an unrecognised resolution all still fail.
Both test files were unregistered: no config/ci_gates entry named either, so neither ran in the
CIO hardening lane. This gate registers the pair. Hermetic: fabricated ps output, fabricated
resolutions, no Ollama, no network, no subprocess; no process is started, stopped or unloaded by
